description: REVALIDATED 2026-08-17. Sequencing correction: this item adds nightly CI plan-capture verification for Snowflake and BigQuery, but neither platform has ever executed a single benchmark run in this project. Prove a live run first under first-live-cloud-benchmark-run-and-publish, then wire plan capture and the nightly job on top of a path that is known to work. Cost is not the obstacle: BigQuery has a permanent free tier of 1 TiB scanned per month, and Snowflake's 30-day trial carries $400 in credits. The real prerequisite is credentials existing in CI at all - .github/workflows/ currently contains zero references to Snowflake or Databricks, so no cloud secret is wired anywhere.

anti_patterns.why: PR-triggered cloud queries from arbitrary branches incur uncontrolled billing; nightly-only.
plans come from the completed QueryJob, not a pre-execution EXPLAIN; test through execute_query().

anti_patterns.dont: query real tables in BigQuery live tests
anti_patterns.why: SELECT 1 is free; table scans bill per byte.

anti_patterns.dont: store the GCP service account JSON in the repo or write it to a tracked path
anti_patterns.why: write to a runner temp file only.

preserves.behavior: BigQuery test queries must process 0 bytes (SELECT 1, no table references) — plan capture must not incur scan billing.
Existing tests in test_snowflake_live.py and test_bigquery_live.py must be untouched.
Live tests must skip (not fail) when credentials are absent — forks and contributors without secrets must stay green.
No secret values may appear in workflow logs; the GCP key file must not be echoed or uploaded as an artifact.
Snowflake tests must not require a dedicated warehouse size — XS with auto-suspend is the assumed floor.

prior_art.concept: tests/integration/platforms/conftest.py — snowflake_credentials / bigquery_credentials fixtures with env-var skip
tests/integration/platforms/test_bigquery_live.py — existing live test file with live_bigquery marker
tests/integration/platforms/test_snowflake_live.py — existing live test file with live_snowflake marker

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/integration/platforms/test_snowflake_live.py tests/integration/platforms/test_bigquery_live.py -m 'live_snowflake or live_bigquery' --collect-only -q --override-ini='addopts='
verifications.description: New live test classes collect under their markers
verifications.expected: New plan capture tests listed for both files
All tests skipped, 0 failures (when no credentials configured)

work_units.notes:
Four-test shape from the PostgreSQL precedent. Snowflake plans come from
`EXPLAIN USING JSON <query>` (per cloud-saas w2), so
test_get_query_plan_returns_json can assert json.loads succeeds.
Fixture variant passes capture_plans=True via snowflake_credentials.
Keep queries trivial (SELECT 1) — warehouse compute bills per second
and auto-resume on first query is expected; use an XS warehouse.

BigQuery cannot follow the capture_query_plan(connection, query, id)
direct-call shape — plans come from the completed QueryJob (cloud-saas
w3 implements _capture_bq_plan). Instead:
  - test_execute_query_with_capture_returns_plan: run
    execute_query(..., capture_plans=True) on SELECT 1 and assert the
    result dict contains query_plan and a 64-char plan_fingerprint.
  - test_plan_fingerprint_stable: run the same query twice, compare
    fingerprints from the result dicts.
SELECT 1 processes 0 bytes in BigQuery (no table scan), so the test
is free; do not query real tables.

Add the new secrets as job-level env vars, add the
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS file-write step from w1, and extend the
pytest invocation by appending ONLY the plan-capture classes from w2/w3 as
node ids — NOT the whole live modules. Selecting the modules with
-m "... or live_snowflake or live_bigquery" would also run the heavy
TPC-H load / warehouse-cost live tests in those files and violate the
SELECT-1 / 0-byte billing guardrails below. Append:
  "tests/integration/platforms/test_snowflake_live.py::TestLiveSnowflakeQueryPlanCapture"
  "tests/integration/platforms/test_bigquery_live.py::TestLiveBigQueryQueryPlanCapture"
keeping -m "live_snowflake or live_bigquery" as a secondary safety filter
so the classes still skip cleanly when credentials are absent. If the
Redshift/MotherDuck job does not exist yet (TODOs landed out of order),
create the job following the postgres-integration pattern in nightly.yml
with only the Snowflake/BigQuery plan-capture classes. Nightly-only;
never pr.yml.
